manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Yannik until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Lagrella until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
